MERGE INTO REP_ASSET_INFO RAI USING (
SELECT '${item.assetId}' ASSET_ID, '${item.marketId}' MARKET_ID, '${item.assetName}' ASSET_NAME, '${item.issuer}' ISSUER, #{item.idate,jdbcType=DATE}null IDATE, ${item.issuePrice}null ISSUE_PRICE, ${item.issueAmt}null ISSUE_AMT, '${item.ccy}' CCY, #{item.vdate,jdbcType=DATE}null VDATE, #{item.mdate,jdbcType=DATE}null MDATE, #{item.actmdate,jdbcType=DATE}null ACTMDATE, '${item.tradeMarket}' TRADE_MARKET, '${item.registOrg}' REGIST_ORG, '${item.inputType}' INPUT_TYPE, '${item.inputUser}' INPUT_USER, '${item.adapterId}' ADAPTER_ID, '${item.status}' STATUS, '${item.createUser}' CREATE_USER, '${item.createDept}' CREATE_DEPT, #{item.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}null CREATE_TIME, '${item.updateUser}' UPDATE_USER, #{item.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}null UPDATE_TIME, '${item.fixAncier}' FIX_ANCIER, '${item.assetTypeOne}' ASSET_TYPE_ONE, '${item.assetTypeTwo}' ASSET_TYPE_TWO, '${item.assetTypeThree}' ASSET_TYPE_THREE, '${item.assetTypeDis}' ASSET_TYPE_DIS ,'${item.disAssetTypeone}' DIS_ASSET_TYPEONE ,'${item.disAssetTypeytwo}' DIS_ASSET_TYPETWO ,'${item.disAssetTypethree}' DIS_ASSET_TYPETHREE FROM sysibm.SYSDUMMY1
) TEMP
ON( RAI.ASSET_ID = TEMP.ASSET_ID )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
RAI.MARKET_ID = TEMP.MARKET_ID, RAI.ASSET_NAME = TEMP.ASSET_NAME, RAI.ISSUER = TEMP.ISSUER, RAI.IDATE = TEMP.IDATE, RAI.ISSUE_PRICE = TEMP.ISSUE_PRICE, RAI.ISSUE_AMT = TEMP.ISSUE_AMT, RAI.CCY = TEMP.CCY, RAI.VDATE = TEMP.VDATE, RAI.MDATE = TEMP.MDATE, RAI.ACTMDATE = TEMP.ACTMDATE, RAI.TRADE_MARKET = TEMP.TRADE_MARKET, RAI.REGIST_ORG = TEMP.REGIST_ORG, RAI.INPUT_TYPE = TEMP.INPUT_TYPE, RAI.INPUT_USER = TEMP.INPUT_USER, RAI.ADAPTER_ID = TEMP.ADAPTER_ID, RAI.STATUS = TEMP.STATUS, RAI.CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, RAI.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, RAI.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, RAI.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, RAI.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, RAI.FIX_ANCIER = TEMP.FIX_ANCIER, RAI.ASSET_TYPE_ONE = TEMP.ASSET_TYPE_ONE, RAI.ASSET_TYPE_TWO = TEMP.ASSET_TYPE_TWO, RAI.ASSET_TYPE_THREE = TEMP.ASSET_TYPE_THREE, RAI.ASSET_TYPE_DIS = TEMP.ASSET_TYPE_DIS ,RAI.DIS_ASSET_TYPEONE = TEMP.DIS_ASSET_TYPEONE ,RAI.DIS_ASSET_TYPETWO = TEMP.DIS_ASSET_TYPETWO ,RAI.DIS_ASSET_TYPETHREE = TEMP.DIS_ASSET_TYPETHREE
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( ASSET_ID, MARKET_ID, ASSET_NAME, ISSUER, IDATE, ISSUE_PRICE, ISSUE_AMT, CCY, VDATE, MDATE, ACTMDATE, TRADE_MARKET, REGIST_ORG, INPUT_TYPE, INPUT_USER, ADAPTER_ID, STATUS, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, FIX_ANCIER, ASSET_TYPE_ONE, ASSET_TYPE_TWO, ASSET_TYPE_THREE, ASSET_TYPE_DIS ,DIS_ASSET_TYPEONE ,DIS_ASSET_TYPETWO ,DIS_ASSET_TYPETHREE ) VALUES ( TEMP.ASSET_ID, TEMP.MARKET_ID, TEMP.ASSET_NAME, TEMP.ISSUER, TEMP.IDATE, TEMP.ISSUE_PRICE, TEMP.ISSUE_AMT, TEMP.CCY, TEMP.VDATE, TEMP.MDATE, TEMP.ACTMDATE, TEMP.TRADE_MARKET, TEMP.REGIST_ORG, TEMP.INPUT_TYPE, TEMP.INPUT_USER, TEMP.ADAPTER_ID, TEMP.STATUS, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, TEMP.FIX_ANCIER, TEMP.ASSET_TYPE_ONE, TEMP.ASSET_TYPE_TWO, TEMP.ASSET_TYPE_THREE, TEMP.ASSET_TYPE_DIS ,TEMP.DIS_ASSET_TYPEONE ,TEMP.DIS_ASSET_TYPETWO ,TEMP.DIS_ASSET_TYPETHREE
)
